title: Best-of-8 cost on the vLLM serving path (shared prefill), the stack the pools were generated with
harness: vLLM, ONE request in flight, enable_prefix_caching=False, cap320 (max_pixels=1280*28*28//4), real vqa_rad open items, NVML power integrated over the timed call across visible GPUs, warmup discarded. Prompt construction is byte-identical to src/labeling/run_openvqa.py:build().
why: bestofn_latency_energy_2026-08-03.json measured HF num_return_sequences=8, which repeat_interleaves the input and therefore encodes the prompt and image EIGHT times. Every candidate-set pool in this project was generated under vLLM with n=8, which forks after ONE shared prefill. This measures the path we actually use.
NOT_measured: the July LoRA verifier arm. vLLM 0.9.0.1 silently drops all 192 visual.* LoRA modules (CLAUDE.md section 0), so a LoRA number from this harness would be wrong. That arm keeps its HF figures and the comparison across the two rows is therefore across two serving stacks -- stated, not hidden.

forward_tokens_per_question.note: forward-tokens is a proxy for FLOPs in a dense transformer (~2*params*tokens). flopeq_shared is what vLLM's within-request n-way fork actually costs; flopeq_as_charged is the HF repeat-8 convention the 2026-08-03 artifact used.
